source.reference: CVE-2026-54290 / GHSA-88fw-hqm2-52qc — hono CORS middleware reflects any Origin with credentials
source.upstream_licence: MIT (hono) — permissive, but the fixture is still written here rather than copied

defect: applyCors reflects the caller's Origin into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, so every origin can read cookie-authenticated responses.
why_it_is_hard: The criterion the change was written for (ac_1) is genuinely satisfied and genuinely tested. The defect is that the same three lines also satisfy it for everyone else, which is a criterion the change never mentions. A reviewer asking only 'does it do what it says' passes it.
notes: Plan level was raised to P2 by a human for externally visible behaviour, which no path derivation can see. deriveActualRisk lands on P1 here, so the block must come from ac_2 being not_met, not from the high-risk row.
